A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete and readable, including their appendices. They describe the same research lineage, retaining AnesBench, its cognitive-demand categories, and many experiments, despite v2's broader AnesSuite framing.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations, CPT/SFT experiments, inference-strategy comparisons, and contamination analysis in Tables 1–4 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, Morpheus training experiments, open-ended evaluations, case studies, and statistical analyses in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: v2 introduces Morpheus-7B/14B, trained through SFT followed by GRPO on AnesR1 reasoning traces generated with correctness-based rejection sampling. This substantially extends v1's own CPT/SFT training procedure and evaluation of externally distilled models. The earlier mini-step, self-reflection, and beam-search procedure is no longer presented.

E1.justification: v2 adds verifiable MCQ/CoT training through AnesR1, actually used for Morpheus, and evaluates 64 System 2 questions converted into open-ended tasks (Appendix G.2). These extend training and evaluation requirements beyond v1. English/Chinese coverage, AnesCorpus, AnesQA, and CAB MCQs already existed; CAB is retained in Appendix G.3.

E2.justification: The MCQ comparisons add Qwen3, Gemma 3, Llama 4, GPT-OSS, Gemini-2.5, and Claude-3.7 models (v2 Tables 3 and 9). R1-Distill-Llama-8B disappears from the complete English and CAB comparisons. The Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct reference row is also removed from the CPT/SFT ablation table, although that model remains evaluated elsewhere.

E3.justification: Reported settings change from two CPT epochs and fixed 2,000-step SFT in v1 to three CPT epochs and five SFT epochs with revised batching in v2 Appendix C.3. Benchmark and corpus sample counts also change. These descriptions do not establish reruns, and v2's equal-step claim needs reconciliation with its epoch-based settings. New protocols include SFT-only controls and open-ended evaluation using BLEU, F1, and two LLM judges.

E4.justification: v2 adds SFT-versus-GRPO controls, Chinese CPT analyses, two comparative clinical case studies, manual data-quality audits, and MCQ/open-ended validation. The explicit beam-search and model-size-dependent distillation analyses from v1 Sections 5.3–5.4 are removed. Sampling analysis now examines Morpheus self-consistency across sample counts; the existing leakage audit and word clouds are retained.

E5.justification: v1 explicitly reports one benchmark run and supplies point estimates without uncertainty analysis. v2 Appendix F adds bootstrap tests, 90% confidence intervals, and correlation/regression significance testing. Appendix G.2 reports three repetitions of open-ended judging. These additions do not establish repeated training runs or additional runs of the retained MCQ evaluations.

E6.justification: All 38 models shared by v1 Table 4 and v2 Table 9 retain their English scores; shared CAB totals also remain unchanged. Substantial additions include Morpheus, newer-model, open-ended, and Chinese training results. For combined SFT data, v2 Table 5 newly reports Chinese accuracy of 65.9% without CPT versus 60.0% with CPT, while retaining the earlier English values. CAB cognitive-level breakdowns and beam-search result entries are removed.

T1.justification: v2 Appendix F.1 introduces an explicit interaction regression for comparing scaling slopes (Equation 2) and coefficient-based hypotheses for diminishing returns. This is a limited addition of mathematical formulation for empirical analysis. The original leakage-confidence definition in Equation 1 is unchanged, and no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion shift from presenting a benchmark and multidimensional evaluation to claiming the first comprehensive anesthesiology dataset suite and dedicated reasoning-model collection. Morpheus and support for CPT, SFT, and RLVR become central contributions. The earlier emphasis on inference-search and general-model distillation findings is reduced or removed.

C2.justification: v2 qualifies v1's positive CPT interpretation with Chinese performance degradation and a possible catastrophic-forgetting explanation (Section 5.2). Appendix F acknowledges weak or nonsignificant support for some CoT, scaling, and dataset-complementarity claims. Section 6 adds limitations concerning abstract clinical scenarios and missing modalities, while Appendix G.2 newly argues for MCQs as a proxy for open-ended reasoning.

D1.justification: v2 substantially expands implementation disclosure: GPU hardware, inference/training frameworks, optimization settings, generation and judging prompts, and explicit decontamination thresholds appear in Appendices A–C and G. Distribution plans now include Morpheus and HuggingFace. However, v1's specified CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license is replaced by deferred licensing information in v2 Appendix H.6; neither PDF establishes that the promised resources are already released.

R1.justification: v2 substantially broadens its novelty positioning from structured benchmark evaluation to a comprehensive training-resource suite and the first specialized reasoning-model collection. New references connect this positioning to RLVR/Tulu 3, GRPO/DeepSeekMath, and newer model families. The earlier small-model distillation discussion and its supporting citation disappear, although much of the general related-work discussion remains.

P1.justification: Beyond scientific additions, v2 extensively rewrites the abstract, introduction, contribution statement, and conclusion. It reorganizes methodology into dataset overview/curation, separates evaluation and baseline models from analysis, and moves training details into structured appendices with a contents page. The title, terminology, citation style, and datasheet organization also change.

P2.justification: v2 redraws the overview around AnesSuite and Morpheus, adds dataset-distribution figures and numerous experimental/statistical tables, and restructures the main comparison table by model category. The scale analysis loses its CAB panel; the beam-search table and distillation chart disappear. Existing leakage and word-cloud figures are relocated, and prompts receive substantially different boxed formatting.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially strengthens validation through documented data audits and decontamination, controlled Morpheus comparisons, open-ended checks, and statistical analyses that qualify previously untested assertions. Its Chinese CPT results expose an important applicability limitation absent from v1's positive interpretation, and implementation disclosure improves substantially. Reporting problems remain: Table 3 gives Qwen3-4B a Chinese total of 0.37 below every category score, and training-budget descriptions need reconciliation. These weaken some quantitative comparisons, but the gains in validation, reproducibility, and qualified interpretation are substantial overall.
